inhomogeneous_deformation.description: First-order deformation of mixed fermion-boson oscillator commutators; kappa is factored on the left
inhomogeneous_deformation.coefficient_convention: Entries encode gamma in [X,Y]_gamma=[X,Y]_0+kappa*gamma(X,Y); since gb and kappa are both declared odd, -gb*kappa is rewritten as +kappa*gb; terms containing kappa^2 are zero.

consistency.parity_warning: The reference assigns odd parity to both gb parameters and kappa, so their product is even although the mixed oscillator commutator is odd. Gamma coefficients are generated formally from the stated exchange relation; this parity conflict remains unresolved.
